I-001.threat: Eavesdropping on embedded bus {{dataFlowName}} between {{sourceName}} and {{targetName}}
I-001.cause: Embedded bus communication is unencrypted and physically accessible — data can be passively captured
I-001.attack: Attacker attaches a logic analyzer to the embedded bus and captures all traffic
